title: Proof of Critch–Morton Conjecture 8 (SIGMA 10 (2014), 095, Section 2, p. 6): reconstruction from any consecutive three-site improper marginal

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Critch–Morton Conjecture 8 (SIGMA 10 (2014), 095, Section 2, p. 6): every consecutive three-site improper marginalization is birational for open-boundary, translation-invariant, binary bond-two matrix product states of length N at least four. An explicit rational inverse over the complex numbers is given on a nonempty principal open domain, with both inverse identities on the affine Zariski closures. A four-by-four linear system reconstructs a three-site representation, and inverse boundary contractions restore omitted sites. Consequences include rationality in dimension seven, reconstruction from every longer consecutive block with arbitrary fixed nonzero site-dependent coherent contractions, minimality of three retained amplitude indices, and exact equations characterizing the reconstruction chart.
summary: Any consecutive block of at least three amplitude indices generically determines an open-boundary binary bond-two MPS rationally, with arbitrary fixed nonzero coherent contractions at omitted sites. Three retained indices are necessary. The N−2 quartic conditions are insufficient globally; explicit reconstruction equations characterize membership on a nonempty chart.
